If we accept that

Sorry, but your

be abnormal. We

patience.

It's your new
partner.

Please take care
of it with love.

We hope to see you
again.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourPartyIsFullTex:
Uh-oh. Your party
is already full.

Please come back
when you have room in your party.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterNoTradePartnerFoun:
It's unfortunate,
but no one has

come forward as a
trade partner.

Would you like
your #MON back?
GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourMonIsLonelyTex:
It's unfortunate,
but no one has

come forward as a
trade partner.

We've held your
#MON for a long

time. As a result,
it is very lonely.

Sorry, but we must
return it to you.

We hope to see you

Fine. We will
continue to hold your #MON.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterRecentlyLeftYourMo:
Oh? You left your
#MON with us only recently.

Please come back
later.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterSaveBeforeTradeCor:
We'll SAVE before
connecting to the CENTER.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhichMonToTradeTex:
Which #MON do
you want to trade?
GoldenrodPokecomCenterTradeCanceledText:
Sorry, but we must
cancel the trade.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterEggTicketText:
Oh!

I see you have an
EGG TICKET!

It's a coupon that
special people can

redeem for a
special #MON!
GoldenrodPokecomCenterOddEggBriefingText:
Let me give you a
quick briefing.

Trades held at the
TRADE CORNER are

between two
trainers who don't

know each other's
identity.

As a result, it
may take time.

However, an ODD
EGG is available just for you.

It will be sent to
you right away.

Please choose one
of the rooms in

the CENTER.
An ODD EGG will be

sent from the
chosen room.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterHereIsYourOddEggTe:
Thank you for
waiting.

We received your
ODD EGG.

Here it is!

Please raise it
with loving care.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterNoEggTicketService:
I'm awfully sorry.

The EGG TICKET
exchange service isn't running now.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhatToDoText:
What would you
like to do?
GoldenrodPokecomCenterNewsMachineExplana:
#MON NEWS is
news compiled from

the SAVE files of
#MON trainers.

When reading the
NEWS, your SAVE

file may be sent
out.

The SAVE file data
will contain your

adventure log and
mobile profile.

Your phone number
will not be sent.

The contents of
the NEWS will vary

depending on the
SAVE files sent by

you and the other
#MON trainers.

You might even be
in the NEWS!
GoldenrodPokecomCenterWouldYouLikeTheNew:
Would you like to
get the NEWS?
GoldenrodPokecomCenterReadingTheLatestNe:
Reading the latest
NEWS… Please wait.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterCorruptedNewsDataT:
The NEWS data is
corrupted.

Please download
the NEWS again.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterMakingPreparations:
We're making
preparations.

Please come back
later.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterSaveBeforeNewsMach:
We will SAVE your
progress before

starting the NEWS
MACHINE.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson1Text:
Whoa, this #MON
CENTER is huge.

They just built
this place. They

installed lots of
new machines too.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson2Text:
I thought up a fun
new thing for the TRADE CORNER!

I make a PIDGEY
hold MAIL, then

put it up for
trade for another one!

If everyone did
that, MAIL could

be traded with all
sorts of people!

I call it PIDGEY
MAIL!

If it becomes
popular, I might

make lots of new
friends!
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson3Text:
They said you can
trade #MON with

total strangers up
here.

But they're still
adjusting things.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson4Text:
Some girl I don't
know sent me her

HOPPIP.
You should trade

for a #MON that
you want.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson5Text:
I received a
female HOPPIP, but its named STANLEY!

That's my dad's
name!
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson6Text:
What is the NEWS
MACHINE?

Does it get news
from a wider area than the radio?
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson7Text:
The #COM CENTER
will link with all

#MON CENTERS in
a wireless net.

That must mean
I'll be able to

link with all
sorts of people.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson8Text:
The machines here
can't be used yet.

Still, it's nice
coming to a trendy

place before other
people.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson9Text:
My friend was in
the NEWS a while

back. I was really
surprised!
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson10Text:
I get anxious if I
don't check out the latest NEWS!
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson11Text:
If I get in the
NEWS and become

famous, I bet I'll
be adored.

I wonder how I
could get in the NEWS?
GoldenrodPokecenter1FGameboyKidText:
The COLOSSEUM
upstairs is for link battles.

Battle records are
posted on the

wall, so I can't
afford to lose.
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson12Text:
I came over here
when I got word

that GOLDENROD's
#MON CENTER has

new machines that
no one's ever seen before.

But it looks like
they're still busy

with all their
preparations…
GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson13Text:
Just seeing all
these new things

here makes me feel
younger!
GoldenrodPokecenter1FLassText:
A higher level
#MON doesn't always win.

After all, it may
have a type dis- advantage.

I don't think
there is a single

#MON that is
the toughest.
GoldenrodPokeCenter1FLinkReceptionistPle:
{PLAYER}, isn't it?

Congratulations!

As a special deal,
a GS BALL has been sent just for you!

Please accept it!
GoldenrodPokecomCenterSignText:
#COM CENTER
1F INFORMATION

Left:
ADMINISTRATION

Center:
TRADE CORNER

Right:
#MON NEWS
GoldenrodPokecomCenterNewsMachineNotYetT:
It's a #MON
NEWS MACHINE!

It's not in
operation yet…
GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFDoYouHaveEo:
Oh my, your pack
looks so heavy!

Oh! Do you happen
to have something named EON MAIL?

My daughter is
after one.

You can part with
one, can't you?
GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFThisIsForYo:
Oh, that's great!
Thank you, honey!

Here, this is for
you in return!
GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFTooBadText:
Oh? You don't have
one? Too bad.
